name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Customer Implementation Leader | Team Leadership, Onboarding Operations & Process Improvement
summary: Customer implementation and onboarding leader with 15+ years in SaaS and e-commerce. Led a team of 20 (later 8) customer-facing onboarding specialists at Wix for two years, delivering 25+ implementations per month personally at 110% of implementation targets, including e-commerce launches for established retail businesses. Builds the processes, training, KPIs, and automation that make onboarding faster and more consistent, and works hands-on in Salesforce, HubSpot, and automation platforms to drive adoption of digital tools.

bullets: Lead end-to-end onboarding for new technology stacks, translating business requirements into configurations and training client teams to adopt them.
Break down manual operational workflows into automated and AI-assisted processes (GoHighLevel, Zapier, Make, n8n), replacing repetitive steps end to end.
Report performance on a regular cadence with KPIs and recommendations, and build dashboards tracking funnel progression and outcomes.

experience.title: Account Executive / Client Strategist
bullets: Coordinated execution across internal departments for multi-stakeholder accounts, holding delivery quality consistent and resolving client concerns promptly.

experience.title: Channel Partnerships & Customer Onboarding
bullets: Led onboarding and training for a high-volume partner network, retaining all but one of 15-20 reseller partners (~94%).
Built scalable communication workflows and automated training sequences that reduced onboarding friction.
Analyzed utilization and performance data in Salesforce to identify adoption gaps and recommend interventions that reduced churn.

experience.title: Account Executive / Sales Operations
bullets: Led the sales team alongside an individual book, and built internal processes that improved reporting accuracy and reduced handoff errors across teams.

experience.title: Account Manager, Onboarding Launch Specialist & Team Lead
bullets: Directly managed and developed a team of customer-facing onboarding specialists for 2 years (20, later 8), overseeing budgets, scope, and delivery for a high-value client portfolio.
Delivered 25+ customer implementations and launches per month personally, holding 110% of implementation targets and 120% of sales targets.
Built and launched e-commerce sites for established retail businesses adding online sales alongside their physical stores.
Drove team initiatives and process improvements for a new vertical that went from proof of concept to a profitable business line, and contributed to hiring, onboarding, and training new specialists.

Escalated account risk to leadership early and resolved it with direct guidance, building trusted-advisor relationships with C-suite clients.
